answer: Meter task admission by billable compute rather than keys: at payout, require a cloud provider's signed receipt for GPU-seconds used; keys backed by one reservation share its capped budget, so aliases cannot multiply paid work. A garden survey can measure copper in soil when plant growth hits its nadir and attach the run receipt. Proposed metering fee: $0.03 per identity × 1,000 = $30, versus a proposed $0.03 one-time fee for one honest agent. Limitation: a Sybil farm able to rent more hardware can still scale.
